description: Shared evaluator cases, run by the backend (JUnit) and the frontend (Vitest); the binding rules are docs/CONTENT_FORMAT.md, "Answer normalisation and tokenisation" (points 1-8), and content/LANGUAGE_GUIDE.md section 11. Each case evaluates `answer` against `exercise` and expects `outcome` (correct, almost_correct, correct_standard_form, wrong) and, for every outcome except correct, the recorded `errorCategory`. Answers: `text` for translate_free and fill_gap without choices (typed: the only answers with tolerance), `choice` for multiple_choice and fill_gap with choices, `tokens` (the tiles in the order placed) for translate_wordbank and word_order, `wrongMatches` for match_pairs; tiles, choices and pairs are exact (correct or wrong). Typed answers, first matching rule wins: equal to a solution; Standard form (standardForms, or for answerLang sq every differing word is the Standard form of the solution word in the lexicon content/gheg_blocklist.json); only missing diacritics (spelling.nasal_vowel if only circumflexes are missing, else spelling.diacritics); Standard form with only missing diacritics; errorHints; same words (diacritics ignored) in another order (grammar.word_order); typo (spelling.other): Damerau-Levenshtein distance on the normalised texts, where a missing diacritic costs 0 and an added or wrong one 1, at most 1 for solutions with at least 6 and at most 2 for solutions with at least 16 letters and digits. Wrong answers without a matching hint take the category of the first exercise skill tag that maps to one (grammar.definite_article.* -> grammar.definite_article, grammar.verbs.jam -> grammar.verb_conjugation; vocab.*, phrase.*, spelling.* and grammar.possessive map to none), else vocab.unknown (typed answers, tiles) or vocab.confused (choices, match_pairs). Answers written with \u escapes are deliberately not in Unicode NFC.
